ImageDescription.value: A cropped section of a photograph of Stalin taken in 1937. The original image depicts Molotov to his left, and Voroshilov to his right

Credit.value: Molotov, Staline et Vorochilov sur l'aéroport central Frounze à Moscou le 25 Juin 1937, lors d'une réunion des membres de l'expédition vers le pôle Nord. Image scannée d'après le livre : Staline. Son soixantième anniversaire. Moscou, Pravda, 1940.

Permission.value: This image is in the Public Domain in the Russian Federation because it was published anonymously prior to 1943 and its author was not revealed in the following fifty years.
